flags.name: --help
flags.description: show this help message and exit

flags.name: --file
flags.description: Specify a file containing a list of DOMAIN=IP pairs (one pair per line) used for DNS responses. For example: google.com=1.1.1.1 will force all queries to 'google.com' to be resolved to '1.1.1.1'. IPv6 addresses will be automatically detected. You can be even more specific by combining --file with other arguments. However, data obtained from the file will take precedence over others.

flags.name: --logfile
flags.description: Specify a log file to record all activity

flags.name: --tcp
flags.description: Use TCP DNS proxy instead of the default UDP.
